patterns.name: Caller evidence inside the delegate's writable set
patterns.generalFixRule: Evidence the caller uses to judge the delegate must sit outside the delegate's writable roots or be excluded from them on every dispatch and resume.
patterns.fix: v2 prose rule; v6 the helper adds exclude_slash_tmp / exclude_tmpdir_env_var automatically when the run directory resolves under them.
patterns.fixStatus: resolved (iter2 onward: every workspace-write run excluded /tmp)

patterns.name: Baseline ordering and coverage
patterns.generalFixRule: Take the baseline before any caller command that could write to the target; it must show which path changed (paths with type and mode, per-file checksums, a copy for content diffs), whether or not the target is a git repository.
patterns.fix: v2 baseline-first rule; v3 numbered step 1; v5 definition; v6 `helper snapshot` / `compare`.
patterns.fixStatus: resolved by the v6 helper (no recurrence after iter5)

patterns.name: Documented field semantics generalized from narrow probes
patterns.generalFixRule: When a documented field comes from single-turn or completed-turn probes, qualify it for resumed and interrupted turns and name the authoritative per-turn record; update every copy of the claim in the same edit.
patterns.fix: v2 running-total wording (a stale copy in constraints.md survived until v3); v10 usage taken from the rollout's per-turn token_usage_record.
patterns.fixStatus: resolved in v10 (holdout H exposed that turn.completed.usage omits an interrupted turn)

patterns.name: Template divergence: conditional flags, cd guard, and per-turn outputs
patterns.generalFixRule: Every flag, guard, and output the prose requires must live in the one template the executor copies; for recurring template-interpretation failures, move the mechanics into a helper.
patterns.fix: v3 complete templates; v4 file-based state; v6 structural rewrite into scripts/codex-delegate.sh (run/resume store and re-pass settings, refuse a missing workspace, write turn-N/ outputs).
patterns.fixStatus: resolved by the v6 helper; this pattern triggered the divergence rule (unclear points 13, 9, 10, 8, 8)

patterns.name: Supervision requirement without a mechanism
patterns.generalFixRule: A required time limit or stop needs one concrete, portable mechanism that targets the launched PID and cleans up after itself.
patterns.fix: v3 watchdog; v4 polling watchdog without orphans; v6 helper --limit and stop.

patterns.name: Process identification by name
patterns.generalFixRule: Identify processes by the PID the caller launched and its recorded descendants, and signal a recorded PID only after its command line still matches.
patterns.fix: v3 descendants file; v10 `helper reap` with command-line guard.

patterns.name: Wait mechanism for callers that may not be able to yield
patterns.generalFixRule: Give an observable test for which wait applies (does the host re-invoke you when a background command exits?), a polling fallback, and one mechanism per turn.
patterns.fix: v5 one-signal rule; v7 `helper check` polling; v8 observable criterion.
patterns.fixStatus: resolved in v8 (no recurrence in iter8-iter9)

patterns.name: Delta brief and brief fields defined by task type or reason
patterns.generalFixRule: Define each brief field with its meaning per task type and an explicit 'none'; define a delta brief by what the resumed turn needs, restating the fields that still apply; list expected failures for phases that leave them.
patterns.fix: v4 per-task-type fields and unified delta brief; v5 carry-over; v10 expected failing set.

patterns.name: Closing format shape
patterns.generalFixRule: Split the question into parts, ask only for those parts and their evidence, mark which lines acceptance depends on, and accept on verified claims even when the format drifts.
patterns.fix: v4 one line per part; v6 split compound questions; v8 accept on verified claims; v10 mark acceptance-relevant lines.

patterns.name: Scope check against a derived summary instead of the authoritative record
patterns.generalFixRule: Check scope against the rollout's tool-call records for the turn (including patch edits and omitted attempts), flag truncated inputs, and count only paths the executor chose.
patterns.fix: v3 denial grep; v7 commands list; v8 tool_calls from the rollout; v9 truncation flag.

patterns.name: Rollout records attributed to the wrong turn
patterns.generalFixRule: Map each helper turn to its own rollout turn_id when it runs, and take rollout fields only from that turn's segment.
patterns.fix: v10 turn_contexts_before.txt / turn_id.txt and per-turn segments; test for re-checking an earlier turn.

patterns.name: Helper output diverging from its own contract
patterns.generalFixRule: Build a dry-run printout from the same argument array as the real launch and test that they match.

nonBlockingObservations: Every executor chose --ignore-user-config; none widened the sandbox or changed the approval policy after a problem.
Several executors ran jev-crosscheck on their own because the user's global CLAUDE.md requires it; they sent only fixture source, diffs, and closing messages.
A few self-attributed issues (redundant waiters, zsh PIPESTATUS, zsh '====' parsing) came from the executors' own shell use, not the skill.
